name: Petersburg city, VA

peers.name: St. John the Baptist Parish, LA

findings: Petersburg city has 207 nonprofit organizations. 77 of them (37%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 59 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Petersburg city has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in Petersburg city list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.6 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 39 organizations here; 43% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
